assignment: Enumerate every live Object(NonMatching, ...) registration, inspect every freshly generated aggregate fuzzy_match_percent 100.0 candidate, and reclaim only candidates that satisfy exact section, byte, relocation, link, and DOL gates; match no new functions

method.registration_parser: Python AST over live Object calls whose first positional argument is the NonMatching name and whose second positional argument is a constant string; this includes multiline registrations and excludes comments
method.score_source: build/GEDE01/report.json freshly regenerated by objdiff-cli v3.6.1
method.join_key: configure.py object path to objdiff unit metadata.source_path after removing the src/ prefix
method.candidate_prefilter: registered NonMatching unit with aggregate fuzzy_match_percent exactly 100.0
method.reclaim_gate: Fresh one-shot objdiff must prove exact generated and retail section ownership and size plus byte-identical code or data and identical relocations; the full canonical link and retail DOL SHA-1 gate must remain exact
method.zero_code_rule: A data-only unit cannot qualify through aggregate code measures because its 100% code score is vacuous; its data sections must independently pass the exact section gate

matched_byte_accounting.note: The data-only object passed the exact section, byte, link, and DOL gates. Objdiff-matched bytes were already counted by the aggregate report, while linked complete data rose by 8 bytes and complete units rose by one. No function was reconstructed or newly matched.

fresh_exact_gate.symbol_granularity_note: Objdiff emits the 85.71429% raw .rodata score only on the retail/left section; the generated/right section has no match_percent field. lbl_80239E10 is 40.0% because the generated symbol spans the full 8-byte merged blob while the retail symbol is size 2. Retail lbl_80239E12 is 0.0%/DIFF_DELETE because objcopy --add-symbol creates a size-zero interior symbol that objdiff omits from the generated side. The synthetic whole-section symbol [.rodata-0] is 100.0%, proving all 8 section bytes agree; the canonical DOL hash independently proves the link result.

candidates.remediation: Force the contiguous retail bytes into .rodata and request lbl_80239E12 at offset 2 with objcopy --add-symbol. The added symbol is size zero and therefore absent from objdiff's generated-symbol view, but it remains link-required by 522 .4byte lbl_80239E12 references across 58 still-assembly .s files (a further 61 .s files define the symbol via .obj/.endobj); build/GEDE01/asm/auto_07_80248C88_data.s is one consumer and contains nine references. The canonical link and retail DOL hash prove exact placement.
candidates.next_action: None; the object is reclaimed and linked. Preserve the symbol-normalization step and exact DOL gate in future build changes.
